raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: Surfaced an auto-generated DuckDuckGo answer claiming Ernest I died on 17 January 1546 (a different “Ernest I,” the Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg), without disambiguating or verifying against primary sources as instructed. This misattribution could directly lead to the wrong date, whereas credible sources (e.g., Wikipedia) state 12 June 1516.
